notes.title: FULL RELEASE!!
notes.notes:
[b][h2]The time is finally upon us.[/h2][/b]
Welcome friends... To the 1.0 release of Serin Fate!! WOOO!! I'm very excited to share the game with you. 

I have poured a [b]HUGE[/b] amount of effort, love, and creative-thought into Serin Fate over these past five years... And I truly think its standing quality will reflect that and present a really special experience. 

I really hope you enjoy, and look forward to hearing your thoughts and experiences on Discord.
[b]Please leave a review on Steam and swing by the Discord to say hello![/b]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/Qn58N92]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/b3b564f2d9f7cb431ff546dfb8b7ee3b6e1090a1.png[/img][/url]

I would like to keep this short... But I think a quick run down is due, of what [i]precisely [/i] Serin Fate is!

[b][h2]Serin Fate[/h2][/b]
[b]A hand-crafted fantasy RPG that delves deep into the churning depths of Magic.
Explore a retro-inspired world bustling with rich story, unique mechanics, and fearsome Monsters!
Encourages an adventurous spirit and offers greater difficulty to the brave who seek it.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/f16ee007e756b83f311658df54f4408527ab6da2.png[/img]

[b][h3]Main Features[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Explore a vast world full of magic.
[*] Epic storyline.
[*] Use Magic, cast spells, practice Witchery.
[*] Capture 50 different types of Familiar.
[*] Train and tend your Familiars, to defeat fearsome monsters.
[*] Level up, spend points, choose a perk path.
[*] Make friends and unravel their stories.
[/list]

[b][h3]Sub Features[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Craft all kinds of weapons, trinkets, armor, potions, and furniture.
[*] Find and complete quests and Witchery errands.
[*] Grow a sprouting potion garden.
[*] Timing events, day-night cycle, and weather patterns.
[*] Play three races: Serin, Val, or Human and customize your appearance.
[*] Hard mode: With more risk & reward.
[*] Zoom on a broom!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/96ecf326722b243a134fae314d1f848f4d307d40.png[/img]

[h3]Let's get this 1.0 rolling!![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/65565206d06d9e76a6e91a251a3815bf4a33428d.gif[/img]

As always, thanks for playing.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/ed14aaa1fe89f550e8133749754e16c05bfd8ba9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/bf5508e87f6bcbf05268e61fede642486d4931e6.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/Qn58N92]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/b3b564f2d9f7cb431ff546dfb8b7ee3b6e1090a1.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: A RELEASE DATE!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone.
It's been a long road, and the super exciting time of release is upon us!! :D

Mark your calendars, tell your friends, join the Discord, and get ready for adventure!
[url=https://discord.com/invite/Qn58N92]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/d7e4ffdd5ac072c25293ed7772cebf45d8660504.png[/img][/url]

Evil is afoot. Bounding into monster-infested lands with newfound magic, YOU must restore the beloved Fate Stone before evil consumes the land. Explore the magical, pixel-art haven, find new creatures, craft equipment, make a unique assortment of friends, and master your practice of Witchery!
Delve into the four main skill branches: Combat, Witchery, Harvest, and Necromancy to become stronger, and fight back the forces of evil!

[b][h1]ON AUGUST 25TH[/h1][/b]

Ahem... 

[b]Making Serin Fate and sharing part of that journey with fans and in the Discord has been AWESOME.
Come hang with us, and I'll be there listening, NOW and on August 25th release day, for your thoughts and experiences with the new 1.0 build![/b]

Without further delay... Here is a first look at what you can expect come release day! Enjoy~
[previewyoutube=y4F8s6EIe5w;full][/previewyoutube]

Out of all the new content coming in 1.0, I would like to highlight just a few fun changes... Let's start with a personal favorite, Necromancy!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/f3efb139ab173102fb9f10a7f71246a16d571cd9.gif[/img]

If you so choose to go to other-worldly lengths to train Necromancy, you will unlock Auras... Or powerful and toggleable passives that drain your Pool (Necromatic Mana) over time. Strategic Aura management can turn the tides of a battle, or even cheat death!!

And to answer the question we're all thinking... [h3]YES![/h3]
You can raise a tiny undead army of destruction!!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/45c4a9806ca715770a8a6780a9fb04c149b1b56c.gif[/img]

Perhaps it's not your thing? Fair enough, how about Storm Turtles!?
Acquiring one of these majestic creatures allows flying-travel to many places around the world map.
Here is a short video to see more about them!
[previewyoutube=MWcJo_0dfCY;full][/previewyoutube]

Speaking of wondrous creatures... There will be [b]50[/b] species of Chimera roaming the lands in Serin Fate on August 25th! Find them, take care of them, and their powerful Magic attacks will take care of you!
For the Chimera you aren't using, or that are just taking a snooze in a pen, viewing and interacting can be done easily in the new interface.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/7db12d46bf57f755c86fbde266996c445782b3c9.gif[/img]

Serin Fate has more QOL and extensive options than ever, and now has full X-input support for PS4, Xbox, Switch, and Steam controllers... Kick back and try it out!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/00f670e4ab6837ea96e6761b1ef8b1052e8a2ecb.gif[/img]

Now... For the story! Serin Fate has an epic adventure that will send you seeking the five long-lost Shard of Fate... On your journey through the different biomes in SF, you will have to use your skills of combat to defeat atrocious Monsters, your wits to solve puzzles, and rely on friends to overcome obstacles... Don't forget to keep your eyes peeled for Chimera or hidden obelisks!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/6baf2c56b955d03394acee7252b53e139e7d2505.gif[/img]

A lot of time has been spent polishing mechanics and aesthetics - everything from ground textures, paths, lighting and clothing styles, to new NPC portraits!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/84da28b6371d9d2a19d363b75e0cfa741c421347.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/32bebf89aa3bdc9f6755f3d86587d35c249bde8c.gif[/img]

Check out this new shop, for all your Ru-Nic-Nak needs :D
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/65565206d06d9e76a6e91a251a3815bf4a33428d.gif[/img]

Don't forget to swing by and have a listen once the OST is live!!
[previewyoutube=Mqs_3PIbLnA;full][/previewyoutube]

As always, thank you all again - I look forward to your feedback, suggestions and come chat on...
[h2]AUGUST 25th[/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/ed14aaa1fe89f550e8133749754e16c05bfd8ba9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/bf5508e87f6bcbf05268e61fede642486d4931e6.png[/img][/url]

Here's a short live announcement and diary from me, about the upcoming launch!
[previewyoutube=ws-1PAcwW7w;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Serin Fate is published by Crytivo.
And a BIG thanks to the team over there for all the help and support.[/b]

notes.title: Content Update 0.5 LIVE NOW!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Hey friends!
Version 0.5 is finally live... The LAST update before release![/b][/h3]

This update rounds a TON of edges, brings a bunch of new content, and makes the game more awesome than ever. I feel really good about the state of 0.5 and the play experience as a whole at this point.

Without further delay, let's look at a few things that will be there in 0.5!

[h3][b]Important announcement at the end![/b][/h3]

At a glance, here is a quick list of some of the main additions:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/901b90d06750e7fb9dfee1c26ff80c13ab9f1a22.png[/img]

First up, there are more than 10 new Monsters that can be encountered and battled. You'll find these Raizor Wraiths in the Void.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/bd79d936612928208a9a002360b312cac7ef0ed6.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/911601b9a2c34162600653e33ef9178de3aa1265.gif[/img]

Some of the new Monsters are VERY strong, but... All is not lost. There are countless balance changes and new attributes to allow you to customize a strong build against the Forces of Darkness!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/ebcd96e1a39bb313c684b669f3ec73f0f1c79b54.gif[/img]

There is even a new combat mechanic "Blade Whirl"!
Consume some of your precious Mana, and hurl your equipped weapon at Monsters dealing powerful blows and apply on-hit effects.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/3a6028d028ec4dc6afb1c11faf32fb5a091b4b31.gif[/img]

Aside from combative obstacles, Serin Fate has gotten a bit more tricky with "The Trial of the Moon".
Without spoiling much, here's a tiny peek.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/54490ed5f2c798b7694895ab9eec0ab1f0dff44c.gif[/img]

How about these majestic Storm Turtles? You'll have to talk to Gokiki the Sage and figure out how to communicate with one...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/afaa26fefdafa1aa071bfc7ed1274fdbcde276e5.gif[/img]

There are many quality of life improvements coming in 0.5, such as crafting from the Magic Box chest type, and the new Chimera Pen inspection.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/65e69d5f397e9a2cf1258fb884f137aa3898dff9.gif[/img]

I don't want to share TOO much more ahead of time... Ok... One last thing! There is a new town layout and NPCs... Meet Laurent.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/67c9a918bd2909540f55d1928dfa62e341a3c947.gif[/img]

Serin Fate has truely become the game I dreamed of making and set out to create some years ago...
It has been a massive undertaking and the entirety of this mechanic list is now a reality.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/d5c3af01d8412adbb7332cbf3a2fc32d66bad2b9.gif[/img]
[b]Even now, Serin Fate is offering 40+ hours of playtime, and the time has come...
As I've talked about on the Steam early access and social platforms, Serin Fate will be receiving a moderate price increase to 20.00$ USD, to fairly reflect the quality and scale that the game has become. This change is currently live.[/b]

Thank you for your continued support as I bring Serin Fate to full release later this year, complete with an epic storyline, bursting with end-game content, and finished with polished controller support and language localizations.

If you have questions or just want to hang, I (and over 1000 others) would love to meet you on Discord.
[url=https://discord.com/invite/Qn58N92]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/d7e4ffdd5ac072c25293ed7772cebf45d8660504.png[/img][/url]

Thank you all again - I look forward to your feedback and suggestions.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/ed14aaa1fe89f550e8133749754e16c05bfd8ba9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/bf5508e87f6bcbf05268e61fede642486d4931e6.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: HUGE Summer Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! For those of you playing Serin Fate already, I hope it’s been a good experience. Any feedback you may have is very appreciated, so please leave a review on Steam -- It will help the future of Serin Fate… Now diving in!

It has been a long and productive 3 months since the first Early Access version was released, and Serin Fate has come a LONG way.
Let’s take a look at some of the main cool additions in this update!

First off, Serin Fate has an epic storyline planned out, and that has begun to take shape. You’ll delve into the inner workings of the World and begin to unravel the plot line! This includes an extensive tutorial for you new Witches!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/ad30a25dbd398141ba370dca734c4237a31f3e2b.gif[/img]

Next up is World development. A new Biome has become playable, nearly doubling Serin Fate’s playable area size -- The Sun Biome. In the Sun Biome, you’ll need special “Heat Proof” gear to traverse it, otherwise you’ll suffer the fiery heat... Adventuring under the cover of night is also an option!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/1b445eaee4940b5c147853d41dbd89d23d7834b1.gif[/img]

And next is maybe your favorite? Chimera! There are 20 new Chimera species that you can find, battle with, and care for at your house. There are 10 new Storm Chimera, and 10 Moon.
If you really like to care for them, you can now breed them… In the right conditions, any of the current 40 Chimera species may partner up and lay eggs… Who knows what powerful little Chim will hatch? 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/d0b0e8db7276120903d8bf14c75f6c33909310a6.gif[/img]

Now… Let’s talk a bit about Witchery. There are some new mechanics and ways to use your precious Mana. As a Witch, you can now establish a Mana Link! Creating a Link has many uses, such as growing plants more quickly, harvesting resources, activating Magic relics, and you can even speed up time!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/7c282a81a4f8d79e38dddebf7c561594595c1982.gif[/img]

On top of Mana Links, there is an arsenal of new spells at your disposal, including fishing spells, gathering spells, teleportation spells and more… This is Ignite (use with caution)!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/18e7806a9209fc8857bba2256b160250d00206ce.gif[/img]

Ok this is all pretty casual so far… Maybe you like a challenge? I do too! Hard mode is now activatable. Playing on Hard Mode is very dangerous; Monsters are much stronger and death is permanent, but there are XP and loot bonuses for the courageous Witch...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/d3dd12e2c67f7c6b71aa88ebd3370775cf8f901c.gif[/img]

Hard Mode or not, enemies have lots of new combat dynamics, and you may find some new Monstrous lurkers at night!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/e27c80b6db09a0e82032a772b6bc8ca10edd399c.gif[/img]

With all this talk of enemies, you’ll need new items, and there’s a whole trove of them to aid you on your adventures. I recommend the Storm Staff if you want to make quick work of your foes!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/0c86cd21a2f92fefd9df31377ba2c93340e6112b.gif[/img]

Guys… I could go on and on, there are countless nuances and hidden depths, loads of rich new NPC dialogues, things to do, places to explore, balance changes, a whole new fancy UI, options menu, and patch note display… There is even a new somewhat secret mechanic, that I’ll let you discover on your own!

To give a general perspective, there are currently: 
- Two whole Biomes
- 40 unique Chimera Species
- More than 20 Spells to learn
- More than 400 items to craft, gather, place and equip (that even surprised me)!
- And a whole lot of NPCs, Monsters, Key Items, Quests and adventure!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/e130ed044c6d73a719af54d852916f46a2ba03f4.gif[/img]

I hope you have tons of fun and enjoy the update!
I’d love to chat with you on Discord, and hear your ideas and thoughts. Together we can make Serin Fate the best it can be.
[url=https://discord.gg/Qn58N92] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/d7e4ffdd5ac072c25293ed7772cebf45d8660504.png[/img] [/url]

If you’re interested in other awesome games, check out Crytivo and join their Discord, too!
[url=https://discord.gg/bVTP9Ut] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/6417ec54022376519e53e763be26da4b47687e2f.png[/img] [/url]

Thank you all for your interest in Serin Fate and joining me onward down the road of development.

notes.title: Serin Fate Monthly Progress Update #5
notes.notes:
October Update is finally here!

We worked very hard throughout those two months. Unfortunately, we had to miss September's DevLog, because we were working mostly on the backend part of the game such as a new procedural generation system as well as game stability improvements, but in October we had a chance to work on some cool and exciting things for you. First of all, we finally tested a new Procedural Generation system. Let us know what you think about that addition ? Now all the maps will look different and you will have a lot of room for replayability in the game. We also added a new Spell casting system and the way how you can learn and obtain spells. You can read more about all those things in details below!

[b]Procedural Generation[/b]
All gameplay has been hand-crafted and we are currently adding controlled-clumps of random generation throughout the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/cff179ea9ba2384c8c49ec00182f897fbec1c552.gif[/img]

This generation will vary depending on the environment. For example, a generation clump in the Sun Biome may only spawn some stones and sticks, as opposed to the dense Nature Biome generation.

[b]Spell Casting[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/438dac0ec3ff017474c9ad2b923f0b8df455053a.gif[/img]

Spells can be obtained and learned. Casting a spell requires Mana and performed from memory, although the spells can be found in the Witchery Note.

[b]Spell Learning[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/23bbbed0a54bc251c20e1dfd1335f245d24e94f9.gif[/img]

Some Spells can be purchased while others can be found at Obelisks around the world!

The Witchery Note will store all sorts of fun game info like recipes, statistics, quests, and the Spells you've learned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/b0af9fc6ba46c85b47576f28c46d382426cc066d.gif[/img]

The Runic Calendar will be in Midtown where it shows the weekly Magical forecast. Some days may be normal while others could have global effects. For example, Monster Day will increase monsters spawning and their strength, and Witchery Day causes a celebration at the Witches Guild! The calendar does not follow a strict pattern, so it’s good to check once a week.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/428b8fbb6c8e5cc6374c27139e8d841c538e9e57.gif[/img]

Once again, thank you everyone for your support and your ideas. We really appreciate them and it helps us to improve the game and add some exciting features that are being requested by you.

In order to leave us feedback you can always jump in our discord channel and drop us a message and don't forget to wishlist the game on Steam! 

[url=https://discord.gg/Qn58N92][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35029598/ae2923d141ee44710d4ccd0d30df6c147e6e9089.png[/img][/url]

Sincerely,
Serin Fate Crew

notes.title: Serin Fate Monthly Progress Update #3
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Welcome to July DevLog![/b][/h1]

Hello guys and welcome to the DevLog#3! There is still quite a journey ahead of us, but this month was amazingly productive and we were able to accomplish a lot of things regardless. First of all, we added more than 40 different equipment items to the game. If you like fashion, well, we heard helmets that look like pumpkins are trending today. Try it and see for yourself. If you would like to go with a more traditional way, then you can try an iron helmet with a red cape. Whatever you may dream about, we most likely have it. 

Each item possesses unique characteristics such as Defense, HP increase, Mana increase etc. Choose wisely - heavy items might provide a lot of HP and defense, but they lack of Mana power, which is so very essential to a young witch! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35029598/b2c2497954dce79576807dc6b7e2dbc6a3eea9dd.gif[/img]

Some items also have a chance to possess different magic attributes which can do all sorts of interesting things. Certain items will help you in blocking poison and some items will add an additional magic effect to your attacks. For example, one of the newly added items is called Angry Cover. Its unique effect will sporadically counterattack, by blasting enemies who attack you!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35029598/40451a2d7fb986381b698898cc68b475d625f0fe.gif[/img]

The Witch Guild that was introduced in previous updates received a new area called Battle Room. Here you will be able to test your Chimera attacks, your magic, as well as your character build. This dummy in the Battle Room might not look very durable, but he surely can sustain a lot of damage! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35029598/e41947649d50ee2e8b14e4eb41cca45b78d10f97.gif[/img]

We hope you like shopping. We introduced two new shop NPCs that will provide you with all the necessary tools that will help you to survive in a world full of dangerous enemies.

Arcanum Keeper handles all sorts of useful spells and Magic items. So if you need a love potion... Well, he might have one ;) 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35029598/3e8349d4f2be482df4dfd1c2cf6b7a4b76e2636b.png[/img]

Banjo the Trader offers some of the best prices in town! There, you will be able to buy general goods such as seeds and all sorts of simple crafting materials and fishing baits for your farm. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35029598/98b9ef69d0c90fbde068e7f465b2dec5d27159ef.png[/img]

What kind of mage you would be if you were not able to increase your power and might and completely weaken your opponents with the power of magic? Different power buffs and debuffs were introduced this month. Boost your Sun Magic and burn your enemies to the ground, unless you encountered one of the epic enemies with whom you won’t stand a chance. In this case, utilize the debuff spell and weaken your enemy in order to get a chance to run away! 

Besides simply buffing yourself and weakening your enemies, if you combine your spells with powerups abilities correctly, you can get very interesting results.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35029598/7f35295ca759591ee8fa058bad92b6c836ee692c.gif[/img]

The world of Serin Fate grows with each day and its population grows with it. Look at the variety of different Chimera that you can currently encounter in the wild forest and deserts. Each Chimera possesses a unique ability that can help you on your journey. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35029598/2833dfce59728590f90e55123d330fd8a8c1a664.gif[/img]

Besides the world of Chimeras, way too many NPCs kept their silence up to this day. We just added tons of new sounds for them which will bring all interactions with NPCs to a whole new level. Check them out here and let us know what you think! 

Oh, and one more thing… Do you remember when we mentioned something about the powerful creatures that you might encounter in the world of Serin Fate? Well, check out his new and powerful ability “Solar Ray”. It's better to have that creature as your ally, rather than an enemy. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35029598/a31bd578de4175c0daa7a0f3edec199386f0a722.gif[/img]

We hope you liked this update and you are eager to learn more about the future of the game and the new things it will bring. 

Please, join our [url=https://discord.gg/bw4HdVw]Discord[/url] in order to find out more information about us and our project Serin Fate. 

Also don’t forget to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/vethergen]Twitter [/url], [url=http://eepurl.com/gyY-Qv]Subscribe [/url]to the latest news about the game and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1070860/Serin_Fate/]wishlist [/url]the game on Steam!
